title: Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion
summary:

Bitcoin Price Briefly Slides to $76,300 as Binance Confirms Hack Estimated at $6.3 Billion

Binance says the attacker reportedly gained access through a compromised employee laptop, and about $3 billion has been frozen onchain.

title: Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026

Strategy reported record $20.91 billion in Q3 2026 operating income, driven by Bitcoin’s rebound, despite declining revenue, negative year-to-date BTC yield, and continued pressure to fund preferred dividends.

This post Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack

Bitcoin price fell below $79,000 as reports of a suspected Binance hack, with outflows of up to $5.8 billion, prompted Tether and Circle to freeze roughly $1.8 to $2.4 billion in stablecoins.

This post Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
